facts.fact: SSMO's catalogue of Sudanese Standards lists Sudanese Standard 4469:2018, an information technology standard on the yield of printer toner cartridges, as equivalent to ISO 19752:2017, and Sudanese Standard 1633-1:2015, on metadata for records, as equivalent to ISO 23081-1:2006.

note: Carried from the qualitystandards study's reading of this document, matched to this study's questions from the fact's own text.
